cases.name: a running actor that is stopped is stopped
cases.test: state.test.ts > State > .status > should be 'stopped' after a running actor gets stopped

excluded.test: state.test.ts > State > .can > should not spawn actors when determining if an event is accepted
excluded.reason: the test asks snapshot.can(), which no step of the actor cases does, and asserts that the fromCallback the transition would spawn never ran; fromCallback is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer), and the spawn is an assign that stores the reference (an actor reference as data is not expressible)
